name: Meross Smart Wi-Fi LED Bulb MSL120HK (HomeKit, US)

radios.note: IEEE 802.11 b/g/n, 2.4 GHz only; enterprise Wi-Fi is not supported.

matter.note: Some Meross shop pages carry a brand-wide 'works with Matter' line, but we found no CSA listing or product spec confirming Matter for the MSL120HK. Not confirmed.

apple_home.note: HomeKit edition; Meross lists Apple HomeKit and Siri.

google_home.note: Meross lists Google Assistant, through its cloud integration.

alexa.note: Meross lists Amazon Alexa, through its skill.

smartthings.note: Meross lists SmartThings for the MSL120.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant has no official Meross integration. The HomeKit edition may pair via HA's HomeKit Device integration, but no official page covers this model.

hubRequired.note: Here this means needing a bridge or hub for basic app control. It joins 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi directly; Meross says no hub is required.

localControl.note: HomeKit control normally runs on the local network, but no official source we found states local control for this bulb.

colorType.note: RGB colour plus tunable white from 2700 to 6500 K.

lumens.note: 810 lm, sold as a 60 W equivalent; 9 W.

bulbBase.note: The US version is E26 for 90–125 V; Meross also sells E27 and B22 versions for other markets.

summary: The Meross MSL120HK is a colour Wi-Fi bulb with tunable white from 2700 to 6500 K, rated at 810 lumens. This record covers the US E26 version. It joins 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi directly, with no hub. Meross lists Apple HomeKit, Alexa, Google Assistant and SmartThings. Matter and Home Assistant support are unconfirmed.
caveats: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only; enterprise Wi-Fi isn't supported.
Meross's model naming varies between pages (MSL120, MSL120HK, MSL120KIT); check the box for the HomeKit edition.
Matter support isn't confirmed for this model.
